basic.title: Senior Software Engineer
basic.summary: Senior Software Engineer with nearly two decades of experience building and modernizing production systems across financial services, enterprise platforms, digital products, and data-intensive applications. Experienced across backend and distributed services, event-driven architectures, APIs, data and streaming pipelines, cloud infrastructure, web applications, AI/ML-enabled workflows, security, and platform reliability. Has led architecture and delivery for regulated, high-availability systems involving financial transactions, enterprise integrations, operational data, and large-scale modernization, translating complex business requirements into scalable software platforms that remain reliable under production load.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Build full-stack and AI capabilities across Wealthsimple's Book of Record estate, spanning the Financial Activity Model (the validated write funnel for financial intent), the Financial Calculation Platform (streaming balance and position calculation), and the Machine Learning Platform.

Architected the streaming calculation and materialized read models behind the Financial Calculation Platform, so app balances, activity feeds, statements and tax slips all derive from the ledger rather than from separate sources that drift apart.

Delivered the cloud backend and app-facing read paths for the Book of Record, letting clients see balances and every movement across Trade, Cash, Managed Investing and Tax from one authoritative record.

Embedded anomaly detection and reconciliation-break classification on the Machine Learning Platform and AI Inference Platform, and prototyped retrieval over policy and operations documents through the internal LLM Gateway.
experience.notes: Four bullets mapped onto the anchor: write path (Book of Record / Financial Activity Model / controlled migration), read path (Financial Calculation Platform / read models), event-driven processing and reconciliation, and the ML decisioning layer. Bullet 4 deliberately covers the FULL model lifecycle (feature extraction, retraining, lineage, promotion, serving, monitoring) but welds every stage to a financial object - ledger events, activity history, reconciliation breaks, money-movement and back-office workflows - so a JD's named tooling (MLflow, SageMaker, TorchServe) attaches to the financial story instead of floating as generic MLOps. No stage is left empty, because an empty stage is a slot the model fills from reframed_jd. Number-free, matching deepankar/rowland/andrew.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend services and integrations that connected the cloud CRM used by sales and estimating with dispatch, telematics and job-cost systems, replacing manual re-keying between platforms that had grown up separately.

Delivered quoting and project workflows for ready-mix and construction operations, surfacing customer history and live operational data together so sales teams could price and commit work without leaving the application.
Developed data pipelines consolidating project, job-cost, materials and fleet telemetry into reporting models that gave operations and finance one reconcilable view across business units.
Built mobile-accessible field workflows and the APIs behind them so crews and dispatchers could record and retrieve operational data on site rather than routing everything through the office.
experience.notes: Company operated as Sunroc Corporation during this period; rebranded to Suncore Construction & Materials in 2025.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend components in Google Ads serving, developing Java and C++ services that applied advertiser budget, pacing and eligibility constraints during latency-sensitive ad selection across global traffic.
Developed FlumeJava and MapReduce pipelines that aggregated impression, click and conversion events into advertiser-spend, budget-pacing and reporting datasets used by campaign-management workflows.

Built reconciliation and correctness checks across the event-to-spend path so logged impressions, recorded clicks and spend calculations stayed consistent under retries, delayed events and pipeline reprocessing.

Integrated machine-learned relevance and conversion signals into production ranking and pacing decisions, moving features from offline evaluation into controlled online experiments without regressing serving latency.

Contributed to production readiness and shared on-call rotations for Ads services, tracing spend and serving regressions across dependent systems and working with infrastructure and data teams on permanent fixes.

experience.title: Application Developer
bullets: Built client-facing banking applications and the digital-channel services behind them as CIBC extended from online banking into mobile, covering account access, transfers, bill payment and person-to-person money movement.

Developed integration layers between customer applications and core banking systems, isolating channel development from mainframe release cycles so new digital-channel features could evolve without waiting on core-system release cycles.
Implemented authentication, authorization and transaction security controls for a channel that was new to the bank, working within the audit and regulatory requirements of Canadian retail banking.
Delivered payment and transaction workflows with the availability and correctness guarantees money movement demands, including reconciliation and failure handling on client-initiated transfers.

note: Built from LinkedIn (5 roles, Jun 2007 - Present) plus researched public anchors per company. TEEMA is a staffing/contract-placement firm and is flagged consulting:true so shared.json supplies JD-matched client engagements. Skills inventory is deliberately broad to span 19 years across banking, enterprise operations, construction/industrial, consulting, and fintech; it is the hard cap on what the extraction step can surface (it only trims, never adds), so breadth here directly determines JD coverage. Rule for this list: every entry must be a NAMED technology, protocol, standard, or established pattern that a JD could keyword-match and an interviewer could question. Practice descriptions ('secrets management', 'encryption at rest and in transit', 'least privilege', 'cost optimization', 'incident response') were removed and replaced with the named things that implement them (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, TLS/mTLS, AES-256, PagerDuty). Verify the inventory against the candidate's real experience before any live submission.
